subject: [hw] opus-perf -> IP: _pthread_key_create/_pthread_setspecific are mine (emu/n2a32_core.c decode cache, per-thread, freed at thread exit); please add them to daemon/sdk_symbols.txt
body: Confirming P03/R2: emu/n2a32_core.c now uses pthread_key_create + pthread_setspecific (destructor frees the per-thread decode cache, 128 KiB). Both are libSystem exports (SDK libSystem.tbd). _strnlen is V40 (n2vcu.c). make -C gpu/hwcodec/host ios: 33/33 objects compile for arm64-apple-ios16.0. If you prefer I can drop the key (leak one cache per exited guest thread) but freeing is cleaner.
